v5.10.7 - Remote Log Viewer Live View sizing fix
Fixed ----- - The Remote Log Viewer's "Live View" panel could grow to roughly the full native height of the streamed portrait phone screenshot (1000px+), pushing the dashboard and logs far down the page and making them hard to find. The panel is now capped to a fixed, reasonable height, with the stream scaled to fit inside it.
